opening_message:
Ticket 1: Terri Koch (employee ID E009) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E009.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Terri Koch (E009) is a full-time Engineer requesting admin access to Payroll. Admin is only allowed when the employee's role owns the system; Engineer does not own Payroll, so maximum is write. Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E009 is a contractor with basic security training (team memory note listed full-time, but Security DB is authoritative). Contractors are limited to read, or write only with advanced training; never admin. Requested admin exceeds maximum, so recommend granting read.

Contractors are never granted admin; with basic training they are limited to read. The requested admin level exceeds the maximum, so the maximum of read is granted.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Terri Koch (E009) requests admin access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- Note 1 (HR): role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommendation for Payroll: write. Says maximum is write because Engineer doesn't own Payroll.
- Note 2 (Security): role Engineer, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation for Payroll: read. Says Security DB is authoritative; contractor with basic training, max read.

Conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor. Security says its DB is authoritative.

Policy:
- full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system. Engineer does not own Payroll → max write.
- contractor employees: read, or write if advanced training. Never admin. Basic training → max read.

If full-time: requested admin > max write → grant write.
If contractor: requested admin > max read → grant read.

Security note is authoritative per its comment. So contractor with basic training → maximum is read. Grant read.

I should submit read.
